_doc: Hand-verified producer -> artifact -> consumer table for FILESYSTEM couplings that the import graph cannot see: one module writes a file, another reads it back, and nothing in either AST names the other. Every writer/reader below was confirmed at a real I/O call site (open/write_text/json.dump/tofile/pickle/os.replace) or at a path helper whose result is passed to one; the `evidence` field records the file:line that was read. A mention in a comment or docstring is NOT evidence and was dropped. `writers`/`readers` are repo-relative paths and are what blast.py renders as WRITES ARTIFACT / READS ARTIFACT lines. Modules that only consume the SERVED RESULT of a reader function (e.g. pipeline.py calling dsf_reader.read_dsf_object_pavements) are deliberately excluded: that coupling is a plain import edge and is already covered by the AST index. Verified 2026-07-26 against 5eecc3f; re-verify after any move of the reader/writer modules.

rows.note: The auto-patch vector layer. layout.to_osm writes it atomically; O4_Vector_Map merges it into the tile's OSM dicos at build time, and driver re-reads its header to decide whether the patch is stale. production_airport_patch only stats/removes it (weak edge).

rows.note: Per-pack derived-data cache. dsf_reader.airport_mod_cache_dir (:1151) is the cross-module contract -- object_terrain_assembly (:286/:463/:793) and post_mesh (:264) import it. agp_reader uses a FLAT sibling (Airport_mod_cache/o4_library_index_<root>.cache) built from its own path helper. Changing the directory name, the pickle payload shape, or the cache-version stamp silently invalidates or corrupts every consumer. O4_Airport_Elevation_Insets.py and O4_Tile_Utils.py were DROPPED from this row: their references are prose only.

The highest-traffic pavement-pack sidecar. Written and read only by dsf_reader, but its SERVED result crosses into pipeline.py:576 and O4_Airport_Elevation_Insets.py:5654 via read_dsf_object_buildings. Gated off by O4_OBJECT_FOOTPRINT_CACHE=0 (dsf_reader.py:1868 region). A stale sidecar books phantom work into later phases -- check the STALE/read log line before attributing any A/B timing delta.

Sibling of the footprint sidecar: shares _object_footprint_sidecar for path+fingerprint and _read_footprint_sidecar for the read; only the prefix and cache-version stream differ. Served result consumed at pipeline.py:1094.

The mesher's elevation raster. NO Python module reads the bytes back -- the consumer is the EXTERNAL Triangle4XP binary, invoked with the path in mesh_cmd. O4_Mesh_Utils only stats it and hard-errors 'You must run Step 1 first'. Candidate row for a '.dem' extension was DROPPED: no .dem file extension exists anywhere in src/tools/tests (every hit is the in-memory tile.dem attribute). O4_DSF_Utils.py and auto_patch/elevation.py were DROPPED: no raster I/O (elevation.py:326 explicitly passes write_alt_file=False).
